Redis Lua: Set TTL
func:
local room_name = KEYS[1]
local ttl = ARGV[1]
local num_fields = #ARGV - 1

return redis.call("HEXPIRE", room_name, ttl, "FIELDS", num_fields, unpack(ARGV, 2))

rules.to: MATCH (p:Place {department: $department, name: $room})MERGE (h:Hazard {type: $type})-[:AFFECTS]->(p)SET h += { level: $level, score: $score, warning: $warning, justification: $justification }, p.dynamic_weight = coalesce(p.weight, 1.0) * (1 + ($score * $k))RETURN p, h;
{	    "department": payload.p ? payload.p.properties.department : payload[0].p.properties.department,	    "room": payload.p ? payload.p.properties.room : payload[0].p.properties.room	}

MATCH (source:Place {department: $department, name: $room}) MATCH (target:Place) WHERE target.amenity = "gatheringPoint" MATCH path = (source)-[:CONNECTED_TO *WSHORTEST (edge, node | coalesce(node.dynamic_weight, node.weight)) total_weight]->(target) WITH collect({Destination: target.name, path: path, weight: total_weight}) AS all_paths, path UNWIND relationships(path) AS rel WITH DISTINCT startNode(rel) AS start_node, all_paths OPTIONAL MATCH (start_node)-[old:SHORTEST_PATH]->() DELETE old WITH all_paths UNWIND all_paths AS res UNWIND relationships(res.path) AS rel WITH startNode(rel) AS start_node, endNode(rel) AS end_node, res MERGE (start_node)-[:SHORTEST_PATH]->(end_node) RETURN DISTINCT       res.Destination AS Destination,       res.path AS path,       res.weight AS total_weight;

name: Redis Lua: Enforce Retention
func:
-- Keys and arguments
local topic = KEYS[1]
local json_payload = ARGV[1]

-- Retrieve the dynamic retention value passed as the second argument
local retention_ms = tonumber(ARGV[2])

-- Get current time directly from the Redis server
-- TIME returns an array: [1] = seconds, [2] = microseconds
local server_time = redis.call('TIME')
local current_timestamp_ms = (tonumber(server_time[1]) * 1000) + math.floor(tonumber(server_time[2]) / 1000)

-- Calculate the cutoff timestamp dynamically based on the YAML configuration
local cutoff_timestamp_ms = current_timestamp_ms - retention_ms

-- 1. Insert the new data into the Priority Queue
redis.call('ZADD', topic, current_timestamp_ms, json_payload)

-- 2. Remove all elements older than the calculated cutoff
local removed_count = redis.call('ZREMRANGEBYSCORE', topic, '-inf', cutoff_timestamp_ms)

-- Return the number of removed elements
return removed_count

template:

MATCH (t:Place {id: $target})
MERGE (s)-[r:{{{edge_type}}}]->(t)
SET r += $attributes
RETURN r;
